title: Ferdinand of Naples
summary: Raleigh names Ferdinand of Naples in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ferdinand, who in the Conquest of Naples would needs fight a battaile with the French. The one-word title would not say which, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book IV, Part I, Chapter II, §. III, sig. 468b
